reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown read Satan's rule as men's voluntary subjection under a real but derivative sway, not an ownership rivaling Yahweh's sovereignty over the earth.

sides.snippet: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
sides.verseText: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

sides.snippet: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
